messages:
Priya S: Heads-up — onsite loop for candidate Maya Chen (SWE) next Wed 9:00am–1:00pm. Need a few logistics items: parking pass, quiet room for sensory accommodations, a loaner dev laptop imaged with Ubuntu+VSCode (no external internet required except repo mirror), gluten-free + vegan lunch options, and a badge/escort from the lobby. Can folks confirm what they can take?

AJ Martin: I have the interview calendar invites on my side. cc @IT Support and @Emily H for rooms/catering.

Emily H: I can book a private room. Quiet Room A (5th floor) is free that morning — I'll reserve and add a "Private interview" sign. I'll also arrange an escort from the lobby. :thumbsup:

IT Support: I can prep a loaner laptop. Plan: Ubuntu 22.04, VSCode, docker, git, and an offline mirror of the repo. Questions: 1) will the laptop need outbound access to GitHub during the interview? 2) do you want a local PAT injected into the VM env or a read-only repo snapshot? ETA imaging: ~48 hours.

Priya S: Thanks — it's in-person pair-programming, so prefer an offline mirror + a short-lived read-only PAT if necessary. I'll create the token and DM it to you. Please label the device with "Maya Chen — Interview" and leave it charged on the table.

Alex F: Facilities/security here. I can pre-provision a visitor badge and meet at the lobby at 8:10am to escort. For the parking pass we need license plate or make/model; Priya, can you get that by Tue EOD?

Priya S: Yes — I'll ask Maya and send plate info by Tue EOD. Also posting candidate dietary restrictions: GF + prefers vegan options. Emily, can you coordinate with catering?

Emily H: Yup — I'll order GF + vegan boxed lunches. Sent the options here: https://catering.redwood.example/menu. I'll put a label on the lunch box with the candidate name and "GF/vegan".

people-ops-bot: Background check status: Completed for Maya Chen. Badge pre-provisioning OK if visitor info received by 24 hours before arrival.

IT Support: Imaging script for reference — I'll run this against the loaner:

```bash
# imaging script (internal)
image-tool --profile ubuntu-vm --packages git,vscode,docker --label "Maya-Chen-Interview"
# create offline repo snapshot
snapshot-repo --repo redwood/internal-example --out /home/interview/repo-snapshot.tar.gz
```

AJ Martin: Quick calendar ask — can we add a 15-min buffer at the end of the loop for interviewer sync? Folks usually appreciate a short debrief.

Priya S: Agreed. I've updated invites to include a 15-min interviewer sync 1:00–1:15pm.

Alex F: Confirmed escort at 8:10 and badge ready if I get plate/license by Tue. I can also leave a map and visitor Wi-Fi pass at the lobby desk.

Priya S: Sending Maya an email now to confirm travel details and ask for plate info. Will DM the PAT to @IT Support after I create it. Thanks all!

Emily H: All set from my side — room reserved, catering ordered, signage printed.

IT Support: Imaging queued. I'll confirm once the device is staged (likely Tue afternoon).

AJ Martin: Perfect — thanks everyone.

Priya S: Appreciate it. :pray:
